name: Jean-Pierre Beltoise
features: dark hair, lean face, motorcycle racer's compact build, determined set of the jaw
bio: Eleven times French motorcycle champion before he ever raced a car, then Matra's lead driver in both Formula One and the sports cars. Drove the MS650 to victory in the Tour de France and the Buenos Aires 1000 km, and set fastest lap at Le Mans in 1970 before the fuel injection let go.
